summary: Full-stack verification of (1) WEB P0 global audio dock -> /now-playing and (2) Arena play-with-friends CHALLENGES + weekly LEADERBOARD across backend, web, and mobile. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass (games catalogue, h2h/group validation errors, create+invite, no-correct-answer leak in quiz, premature-finalize blocked when host submits before invitee accepts, accept pulls invitee + awards winner on dual submission, listing buckets, /score, leaderboard global/friends/per-game). WEB P0: sf-audio-dock renders on /radio with autoplay; data-testid 'sf-dock-expand' navigates to /now-playing?ch=<slug> and rl-now-playing + rl-follow-show-btn + rl-clip-btn all mount (clip btn is enabled because audio was active, matching option b). WEB Arena at /social?tab=challenges: arena-tab, arena-subtab-challenges, arena-subtab-leaderboard, arena-new-challenge-btn, arena-create-modal with arena-create-game-trivia, arena-create-mode-h2h, arena-create-friend-user_b1106f71a18042bb (Free Tester), arena-create-submit all present; leaderboard shows arena-lb-scope-global/friends, arena-lb-game-all/trivia/quiz and 2 live rows (Demo Listener 1706, Free Tester 572). MOBILE Arena (Expo web preview @ 390x844): social-tab-challenges, arena-tab, arena-subtab-challenges/leaderboard, arena-new-challenge-btn, arena-create-modal + all create testIDs, arena-create-mode-group also present, arena-leaderboard mounts on leaderboard subtab with 2 rows. Parity: both surfaces render identical Arena contract against the shared backend. No functional blockers.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on react-native-web. Use 'boxShadow' instead. Non-blocking but worth sweeping across mobile styles.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (RN Web update). Non-blocking.

Require cycle: app/(tabs)/social.tsx -> src/social/wall.tsx -> app/(tabs)/social.tsx — can cause uninitialized values. Refactor to break cycle. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/social.tsx <-> /app/mobile/src/social/wall.tsx

action_items: (nice-to-have) Sweep mobile styles to replace shadow* with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to clear RN Web deprecation warnings.
(nice-to-have) Break the require cycle app/(tabs)/social.tsx <-> src/social/wall.tsx.

Group-mode E2E could not be fully round-tripped because demo only has 1 friend (Free Tester). Validation path (400 group_needs_two) is covered. If end-to-end group needed, seed one extra accepted friendship for demo.
